title: Abilities
description: Activatable actions over a FIXED kind library, the same principle as mechanics archetypes: parameters, never freeform code. An entity references abilities by id; the compiler bakes them into slots bound to the ability_1..N input actions.

kind.description: projectile = fires a travelling shot; melee_arc = an immediate wide swing; heal = restores hp; dash = a burst of movement.

power.description: damage for projectile/melee_arc, hp restored for heal, pixels of travel for dash.

range.description: projectile: how far the shot travels before expiring. melee_arc: reach. Ignored by heal and dash.

speed.description: projectile only: travel speed in px/sec.

sprite.description: projectile only: the shot's sprite. The `projectile` archetype (arrow/fireball/bolt/knife/shuriken) is the natural pick.
